corpus.scope: Deterministic exact-candidate regression evaluation for the six supported extractor identities.
corpus.limitations: The frozen corpus is deliberately small and is not representative of live-web prevalence, source drift, or user review-correction rates.

interpretation.exactMatch: A produced candidate must match the golden field name, value, raw value when present, provenance pointer, extraction method when present, and confidence.
interpretation.precision: exactMatches / produced; null with no_data when no candidate was produced.
interpretation.coverage: exactMatches / expected; recall is emitted as the same value; null with no_data when no candidate was expected.
interpretation.falsePositive: A produced candidate that cannot be paired with an identical golden candidate in the same fixture case.
interpretation.falseNegative: A golden candidate that cannot be paired with an identical produced candidate in the same fixture case.
interpretation.calibration: ECE and Brier score use produced candidates only. False negatives have no confidence and are never assigned an invented value.
interpretation.status: pass or fail applies only once the metric-specific minimum sample count exists; otherwise status is insufficient_data or no_data.
interpretation.thresholdSummary: Adapter and field status counts are reported separately from pooled overall metrics so aggregate volume cannot hide a local failure.
interpretation.prohibitedUse: These extractor-quality measurements are not an ATS score, candidate score, hiring-probability score, or verified evidence about a person or employer.
